data_quality_notes.resolution_shortcut: Normal images are uniformly tiny square crops (41-89px). Conjunctivitis images are full rectangular eye photos (117-741px). This systematic domain difference means the model may partly rely on resolution/resampling artifacts rather than biological features alone. Matched-resolution data is needed to fully validate clinical utility.
data_quality_notes.deduplication: Removed 3 near-duplicate dHash collision pairs and 39 pre-augmented (aug_*) files.
data_quality_notes.cross_split_leakage: Zero exact MD5 or dHash collisions remain across train/val/test.
